current_round.prompt:
From: Ethan Jacobson <ethan.jacobson@insurity.com>
Subject: Goal wedged in Review �X approve blocked by missing Governance settlement after a superseded integration push

Body:
**Summary:** A Goal that passed Quality and Governance (both bound to the current candidate commit) reached `review` after its governance-**integration** push failed non-fast-forward and the workflow attempt was superseded. The durable "Governance succeeded" settlement was never written, so `approve` refuses with *"reached review without successful Governance evidence"* �X and no CLI transition can repair it from Review.

## Repro
1. Goal passes Quality + Governance evaluation on candidate commit X.
2. Governance-integration push to the round branch is rejected (non-fast-forward); attempt is superseded.
3. Goal still lands in `review`, but with no settled governance record.

## Observed
Goal stuck in `review`. All four gate sub-states (`constitution/rule/product/meta_rule`) = `passed`, `governance_candidate_commit` == `goal.candidate_commit`, yet every lever refuses:
- `approve` �� "reached review without successful Governance evidence"
- `retry --stage governance` �� "not allowed for Review"
- `resolve-merged` �� "can only resolve an already-merged candidate from quality"
- `undo` �� refuses, points to "submit a new round"

No forward path exists. The fix was actually integrated (present on the target branch under a content-equal commit), but the Goal cannot be marked Done.

## Expected
Either (a) `approve` should accept a Goal whose gates passed and whose candidate is integrated, or (b) a recovery op (e.g. `resolve-merged` or `retry --stage governance`) should be permitted from Review to re-settle governance.

## Example
- Goal `00000SZW7P0CKH8X2VDT7CG000`, candidate `f5128caef`.
- Integration push failed 2026-08-26T17:04:52Z (non-fast-forward), superseded 17:04:53Z.

Prefer real module boundaries and stable public APIs over arbitrary chunks or include-only shards. guidance_candidates.name: Cohesive code files
guidance_candidates.rule: Apply whenever an agent adds or changes code files in any language.

agent_context.workflow_summary: Refine gives this Goal Agent an isolated worktree and a finalized implementation plan. Implement the current Round and report evidence; a separate agent will review and correct the candidate in Quality, then an independent Governance gate will verify policy and integrate the exact passing commit before human Review. Do not directly advance Goal state, approve, merge, or push.

result.summary: The plan covers guarded Review recovery, exact-candidate proof, publication failures, and atomic fenced settlement.

checklist.description: Allow the shared Governance retry operation from Review only when the current Round has passed Quality and Governance evidence bound to its recorded candidate but lacks successful integration settlement, atomically retaining the recovery reason and prior diagnostics while retiring stale attempt authority and returning the Goal to Governance for a fresh scheduler claim.

At Governance resume, acquire the existing integrated-target lease and inspect the recorded candidate and freshly observed local and required published targets before workspace preparation, candidate refresh, or Round-branch publication, reconstructing missing integration evidence only when normalized passed Quality proof and candidate-bound Governance evidence authorize that exact integrated ancestor.

When integration or required publication remains incomplete, resume the existing workflow from the recorded candidate identity under the target lease, requiring ordinary integration or candidate refresh with replacement Quality and Governance for content-equal commits with different identities.

Route an authoritative attempt's non-fast-forward Round-branch publication failure through the existing bounded integration recovery, retaining candidate identities, local and remote tips, conflicting refs, and failure diagnostics while preventing superseded attempts from changing replacement work.

Centralize successful integration settlement within the existing workflow and work-item capabilities, rechecking Round, node, attempt, candidate, and gate authority under the Goal lock before atomically recording success with Review and requiring that evidence at every automated Review entry.

Make interrupted and repeated settlement recoverable from retained evidence and fresh Git observations, recording completed Git effects on their originating Round after cancellation or supersession without restoring stale authority or advancing the replacement Round.

Keep CLI and API Governance retry handlers on the shared eligibility path and make missing-settlement approval errors identify that path when eligible while preserving approval as acceptance of durably settled integration.

Update the affected Governance, Review, merge-and-review, and CLI intent pages in their established format to explain recovery eligibility, exact-candidate integration and publication requirements, and retained failure boundaries.

result.summary: Add a guarded Governance retry for Goals stranded in Review so Refine can recover or finish integration of the exact approved candidate, durably settle success before returning to Review, and preserve prior evidence when an attempt is interrupted or superseded.

checklist.description: Allow the existing Governance retry operation from Review only when the current Round has passed Quality and Governance evidence bound to its recorded candidate but lacks integration settlement, atomically preserving the recovery reason and prior diagnostics while retiring stale attempt authority so the scheduler can claim a fresh attempt.

At Governance resume, inspect the durable candidate and freshly observed local and required published targets before workspace preparation, candidate refresh, or Round-branch publication, reconstructing missing integration evidence only when normalized passed Quality proof and candidate-bound Governance evidence authorize that exact integrated ancestor.

When the exact candidate is not fully integrated and published, resume the existing integration workflow from its recorded identity, treating content-equal commits with different identities as requiring ordinary integration or candidate refresh with replacement Quality and Governance rather than transferring the old verdict to another commit.

Route an authoritative retry's non-fast-forward Round-branch publication failure through the existing bounded integration recovery with retained candidate identities, local and remote tips, and failure diagnostics, preserving conflicting refs and leaving replacement work untouched when the attempt is superseded.

Concentrate integration settlement in a focused module within the existing workflow and work-item capabilities that rechecks Round, node, attempt, candidate, and gate authority under the Goal lock, atomically records successful integration with Review, guards other automated Review entry paths against missing evidence, and makes interrupted or repeated settlement recoverable while retaining completed Git effects on their originating Round after cancellation or supersession.

Route the existing CLI and API Governance retry handlers through the shared recovery eligibility check and make missing-settlement approval errors identify the supported retry path while keeping approval limited to accepting the durably settled integration.

Update the affected Governance, Review, merge-and-review, and CLI intent pages in their established format to describe the recovery entry condition, exact-candidate and publication requirements, and retained failure boundaries.

result.summary: Add a guarded Governance retry for Goals stranded in Review so Refine can recover or complete exact-candidate integration, durably record its success, and return the Goal to an approvable Review state while preserving prior evidence and fencing superseded attempts.
